request.prompt: Inside a cramped abandoned projection booth, an old 35mm film projector with its lamp flickering on by itself, the beam shooting through a small window into the dark hall, swirling dust in the beam. Cinematic film still from a 1990s Chinese arthouse mystery film, shot on 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, anamorphic lens, muted desaturated teal and amber palette, deep shadows, halation around lights, fine film grain, hyper-realistic, dreamlike, wide 2.39:1 framing with all important content in the central horizontal band.
